headline: Sales and operating profit more than double
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 119.8B, up 144.4% y/y and 73.9% q/q, and operating profit was KRW 78.9B, up 195.8% y/y, for a margin of about 65.9%.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the preliminary filing reports net income of about KRW 42.1B, roughly 30% below consensus, while revenue and operating profit were slightly above it. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of a preliminary filing. Net income differs between the Yahoo shard (KRW 43.0B) and coverage (KRW 42.1B). Shard operating income (KRW 105.7B) does not match the reported KRW 78.9B and is not used.
